english_scenario: Invoke Python core with no GUI or platform and a typed parse request.
english_expected_property: Return qualified Result/Failure with provenance; no artificial Job or Chat dependency.

english_scenario: Admit a user command, compute a domain result, write bytes, validate/publish and assess.
english_expected_property: Prove each transition separately; a successful handler alone is not published or accepted Work.

english_scenario: Retry/revise execution for the same accepted goal.
english_expected_property: Preserve Work objective and two distinct Run/revision/outcome identities.

english_scenario: Send the exact same admission key and plan digest twice.
english_expected_property: Deduplicate accepted admission under its defined scope; prevent duplicate effect.

english_scenario: Submit different parameters using an existing idempotency key.
english_expected_property: Reject as a conflict before physical execution.

english_scenario: Commit admission then kill process before an Attempt starts.
english_expected_property: Preserve accepted Work/Run without inventing worker-start evidence.

english_scenario: Request and confirm a stop before any external mutation.
english_expected_property: Record stopped Attempt and effect definitely not applied only with supporting evidence.

english_scenario: Request cancellation during an in-flight externally committed write.
english_expected_property: Keep cancellation requested and effect UNKNOWN/confirmed as observed; do not fabricate cancelled outcome.

english_scenario: A worker dies during effect-free mathematical calculation.
english_expected_property: Record interruption, leave Work open and admit a new Attempt only by applicable policy.

english_scenario: Remote output commit succeeds but ACK is lost.
english_expected_property: Reconcile effect state using stable identity; never blindly repeat an ambiguous write.

english_scenario: Some outputs are written while others fail.
english_expected_property: Do not claim a completed collection; qualify partial publication under explicit bundle policy.

english_scenario: Output bytes reach storage but catalog transaction is incomplete.
english_expected_property: Recover or quarantine and never issue a false published Artifact receipt.

english_scenario: Read a damaged state snapshot on restart.
english_expected_property: Replay verifiable journal if available or report explicit corruption; no silently blank new history.

english_scenario: Detect invalid event sequence at the end of a durable log.
english_expected_property: Stop at verified prefix and flag potentially affected effects UNKNOWN.

english_scenario: Two workers attempt committing the same generation.
english_expected_property: One accepted write; the other conflicts or is serialized with revisions/fencing.

english_scenario: Worker A resumes after its lease was replaced by B.
english_expected_property: Reject A's stale publication through fencing or generation-version proof in multiworker profile.

english_scenario: Plan deletion, revoke authorization, then run the plan.
english_expected_property: Re-evaluate permission immediately before effect; no deletion proceeds on stale grant.

english_scenario: The platform data root is absent or read-only.
english_expected_property: Expose degraded diagnostics; refuse effectful Job without losing accepted state.

english_scenario: External environment reports degraded health during domain computation.
english_expected_property: Keep platform Problem separate from domain Job state; do not overwrite analytical result.

english_scenario: Principal A requests private Case of principal B.
english_expected_property: Filter or deny according to actual ACL, including sensitive diagnostic logs.

english_scenario: An external data source fails to respond or reports HTTP 404.
english_expected_property: Distinguish unavailable/fetch-failed from publisher-confirmed absence of an official series.

english_scenario: Source bytes change after an issued analytical result.
english_expected_property: Retain prior vintage and derived result, update currentness/reliance separately.

english_scenario: Publish a reconstructed statistical result relying on non-unique inference.
english_expected_property: Preserve evidence tier, bounds and assumptions even when output workbook is valid.

english_scenario: The method runs correctly but a reviewer rejects its result.
english_expected_property: Execution may succeed while acceptance fails; Work remains open under stated criteria.

english_scenario: A written Artifact fails a checksum or validation rule.
english_expected_property: Quarantine or reject publication; preserve any previously valid generation.

english_scenario: Worker reports SUCCESS but a required result file is missing.
english_expected_property: Qualify Job/Artifact outcome, require review; do not auto-close parent Work.

english_scenario: An admitted host continues while its Windows UI disconnects.
english_expected_property: Reconnect to actual host authority and show verified Run progress; no fake local resume.

english_scenario: Trigger a command through schedule or AI rather than UI.
english_expected_property: Apply the same effect/authorization/admission policy, with no implicit privilege elevation.

english_scenario: Modify success criteria after an earlier Work was accepted.
english_expected_property: Create an auditable successor/revision and preserve prior closure; never rewrite past approval.

english_scenario: Restore archived state and check its operational meaning.
english_expected_property: Verify coherent Work, effects and artifact catalog, not just the existence of copied files.
